LightningComponentBundle.masterLabel: File JSON Review + Field Mapping Demo
LightningComponentBundle.description: Example host: reviews a file with fileJsonReview and extracts the JSON into Salesforce records — or checks it for compliance — via JsonMappingService and JSON_Field_Mapping__mdt.

property.name: contentDocumentId
property.label: Content Document Id
property.description: Id of the file (ContentDocument) to review.

property.name: mappingSetName
property.label: Mapping Set
property.description: Mapping_Set__c of the JSON_Field_Mapping__mdt rules applied on save.

property.name: mode
property.label: Mode
property.description: Extraction writes the values; Compliance compares them with the data model. A rule's Mode__c overrides this per field.

property.name: mismatchHandler
property.label: Mismatch Handler Class
property.description: Apex class implementing IComplianceMismatchHandler invoked when a Compliance run finds mismatches, e.g. ComplianceTaskHandler.

property.name: height
property.label: Height
property.description: CSS height of the review component.
